zh.title: 德國 BFU 公布越南航空 787 慕尼黑事故期中報告　起飛滑跑曾出現煞車輸入
zh.summary: 期中報告記錄飛機在越過 V1 後出現左右不對稱煞車指令，最終由跑道末端外草地升空；調查仍未作成原因結論。
body: 德國聯邦航空事故調查局（BFU）於 2026 年 9 月 28 日發布 BFU26-0757-AX 期中報告。2026 年 7 月 29 日，越南航空一架 Boeing 787-9 在慕尼黑機場（MUC） 26L 跑道起飛前往河內時越過跑道末端，飛機由草地升空並撞毀 20 具進場燈。
飛航資料顯示，機組推進油門約 3 秒後，煞車控制單元曾記錄左側最高約 27%、右側約 17% 的煞車指令。飛機約 18 秒維持在 168 節附近，最後在約 163 節開始抬輪；該航班載有 271 名乘客、12 名客艙組員及 4 名飛行員，無人受傷。
BFU 表示飛機結構完整性受損，調查仍在進行。期中報告只整理目前掌握的事實，尚未認定煞車輸入來源，也沒有作成事故原因或責任結論。

en.title: BFU interim report records brake inputs during Vietnam Airlines 787 Munich takeoff
en.summary: Flight data show asymmetric braking after takeoff thrust was set, before the aircraft lifted off from grass beyond runway 26L; investigators have not determined a cause.
body: Germany's Federal Bureau of Aircraft Accident Investigation published interim report BFU26-0757-AX on September 28, 2026. On July 29, a Vietnam Airlines Boeing 787-9 bound for Hanoi overran Munich runway 26L, became airborne from the grass and struck 20 approach lights.

Recorded data show brake commands beginning about three seconds after takeoff thrust was set, peaking at roughly 27% on the left and 17% on the right. Airspeed remained near 168 knots for about 18 seconds and rotation began at about 163 knots. The flight carried 271 passengers, 12 cabin crew and four pilots; nobody was injured.

The BFU classified the aircraft as having sustained damage affecting structural integrity and said the investigation remains in progress. The interim report is a factual update: it does not determine the origin of the brake commands or assign a cause or responsibility.
